lines.text: There's a field in you that's been holding stubble for years, the old defeat that sold you cheap.
And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Esau for stubble, and they shall kindle in them, and devour them.
Let it burn. The fire that's clearing that field is the same fire God already put in you.
Walk through what's left of it. There's a gate still standing on the other side.
Here's what they don't tell you: the ground behind that gate was already signed over to your name.
So stop visiting your inheritance. Walk the land. It's already yours.

bold: the same fire God already put in you
title: Word and Faith Network
subtitle: Possess Your Possessions
story: A traveler stands before a burning dusk field as the old stubble catches fire, walks through a glowing stone gate into the night, and arrives at dawn in a fruited vineyard with arms lifted - a short visual parable of Obadiah 1:17-18, on letting the old defeat burn and walking into the inheritance God already signed over to you.
